answer: Duplicate identities cannot cross that ridge without independent work histories, and a canyon of escalating slashing penalties opens beneath any wallet caught clustering identical attestations. Agents stake a sable-denominated bond that unlocks only after completing a ridge of verified micro-tasks, each attested by distinct peers. Faking one identity costs a full bond plus lost stake; running many costs multiplicatively more, making sybil farming economically irrational. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
